intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, VCs poured $1.4bn into crypto in January, spotlighting institutional infrastructure. Kraken-backed SPAC raises $345M on Nasdaq while TheDAO relaunches with $220M for Ethereum security.

top_signals.title: Kraken-Backed SPAC Closes $345M Nasdaq IPO
top_signals.summary: KRAKacquisition Corp, a SPAC sponsored by Kraken's affiliate Payward Inc., Tribe Capital, and Natural Capital, closed an upsized $345 million IPO by issuing 34.5 million units at $10 each, with trading commencing on Nasdaq under ticker KRAQU on January 28, 2026. Each unit includes one Class A ordinary share and one-quarter of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share, positioning it as a vehicle for institutional investors seeking exposure to digital asset infrastructure like blockchain frameworks and compliance solutions. The proceeds are held in trust for 18-24 months to pursue a merger with a private target, offering protected capital return if no deal materializes while signaling strong demand for crypto-linked public market opportunities. This listing underscores growing convergence between traditional finance and cryptocurrency sectors for sophisticated portfolios.

top_signals.title: TheDAO returns with $220m to fund Ethereum security 10 years after catastrophic hack
top_signals.summary: TheDAO is relaunching nearly 10 years after its infamous hack, with plans to stake approximately 75,000 unclaimed Ether to fund Ethereum security initiatives. This move aims to bolster the security of the Ethereum ecosystem.

top_signals.title: VCs indulge in $1.4bn crypto bonanza in January
top_signals.summary: Venture capital investment in crypto reached $1.4 billion in January, indicating renewed interest in the sector. Institutional infrastructure is the most popular sector for investment.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin And Ether ETFs Post $1.82B Outflows Across Trading Week
top_signals.summary: Spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs experienced significant outflows of approximately $1.82 billion during the trading week. This outflow is attributed to weakening sentiment in the crypto market and a rally in precious metals.

top_signals.title: US Treasury Sanctions Iran-Linked Crypto Exchanges for First Time
top_signals.summary: The US Treasury has sanctioned two crypto exchanges linked to Iran, marking the first time digital asset platforms have been targeted as part of sanctions evasion efforts. This action signals increased regulatory scrutiny and potential restrictions on crypto exchanges facilitating transactions with sanctioned entities.
